proof-statement-integrity.evidence: Two declarations shared the fully-qualified name QOU.BraidKnot.SixTermPerDerivationWeights.binding_assembly, in the same namespace, in two files. The one the lean.ref actually resolves to (measured with resolveCanonicalLean, the resolver the QA sweep uses) was SixTermPerDerivationWeights.lean, holding "opaque binding_assembly (Z N : Nat) : Float" - an opaque constant asserting nothing, with a Float standing for a mass in MeV. The other, SixTermPerDerivationWeights/binding_assembly.lean, held BindingAssemblyContext (4 data fields + claim_six_term_recovery) and projected that field (3b-cond item 5) - and was unreachable, since the direct module path wins when it declares the named decl. That is the MIRROR of the 0a sibling-shadowing case: a library module path hiding a file in its own subdirectory. No module imports either; nothing in content/ names BindingAssemblyContext. Zero consumers.

trap-superlative.evidence: 'The atomic binding energy derives directly from the SIX terms. It requires ZERO empirical parameter fits' — both absolutes are undercut by the block's own proof sibling.
trap-superlative.notes: PROPOSED: say how many terms actually contribute and for which atoms. THE PROOF SIBLING RECORDS: T_4's bound-free differential 'vanishes ... identically', and T_6 'currently returns 0 for A >= 5 atoms' — so for 8 of the 12 tabulated atoms only THREE of the six terms contribute. The proof's Open-questions section states this plainly; this block does not. On 'zero empirical parameter fits': the proof lists three hardcoded constants, E_0,beta = 0.78233341 MeV (CODATA beta-decay Q, i.e. the CAL-2 proxy), alpha = m_e x 8G = 3.74446989 MeV, and m_e (CAL-1). Taking calibration inputs is not fitting, so the claim is defensible in kind — but the p and n rows of the sibling tables are 0.000 BY CONSTRUCTION (they are the free-particle baseline), and the headline 0.184% mean includes them; over the 10 genuinely predicted rows it is 0.2209%. Also, alpha's hardcoded value is high by 2.73 ppm against its own definition (recomputed m_e x 8G = 3.744459660 at 25 dps with CODATA m_e = 0.51099895069 and 8G = 7.327724753417752), and Term T_3 in the sibling table carries an undefined z^2 whose convention is unstated (D, z = q^3/(q^2+1) = 0.6126880371, is canonical; C, z = sqrt q/(q+1) = 0.4993203342, is excised).
